name: zdeclient_crater_create_feature
description: zDEClient_Crater::CreateFeature creates one crater display node, generates ring and center polygons, binds the display instance to the node, and records the feature context.
known_limits: The smoke target covers the material/UV-enabled success path; display-instance allocation failure is documented from Binary Ninja assembly and deferred to the coherent zDEClient crater feature pass.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zDEClient crater/clip-patch source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x457140 validates CreateFeatureNodeAndDiFromClipPatchPartition with the first clip partition, node naming and callback-context binding, display-instance failure return, featureFlags 0x1008 material/UV branch, center-y depth adjustment, UV and midpoint allocation, midpoint/UV generation loop, ring quad and center triangle AddPolygonToDi loops, midpoint/UV frees, gwNodeSetDisplayInstance, and 0/-1 returns.

The native crater build/create smoke verifies the feature node is allocated and attached to the camera node, named ZDEC_FEATURE, pointed back to the feature, bound to the DI pool display instance, populated with six polygons, and lowers the feature center Y by depth.
